judge.governing_law_identified: Conservation of water volume, spherical-drop surface energy E=4πR^2γ, and kΔE=½Mv^2
judge.regime_assumed: Two identical spherical drops merge into one spherical drop; all water volume is conserved and a fraction k of the released surface energy becomes translational kinetic energy

judge.governing_law_identified: Hydrostatic pressure balance, dP/dz = -rho g, with boundary condition P(0) = P0
judge.regime_assumed: Incompressible fluid at rest; z is measured upward from the undisturbed free surface

judge.governing_law_identified: Hydrostatic pressure P = P0 - ρgz; atmospheric pressure gives no net horizontal force, so integrating the gauge-pressure force over the boundary gives f_x = (ρg/2)(z_2^2 - z_1^2).
judge.regime_assumed: Static fluid of constant density with uniform atmospheric pressure; f_x is a signed force component per unit length along y.

judge.governing_law_identified: Static horizontal force balance: pressure force f_x plus surface-tension components γ cos θ_2 − γ cos θ_1 equals zero.
judge.regime_assumed: Static water block with the stated angle convention and uniform surface tension.

judge.governing_law_identified: Hydrostatic pressure balance with surface-tension force balance, yielding (rho g/2) z^2 + gamma cos(theta) = constant
judge.regime_assumed: Static water surface with uniform surface tension and constant density; no small-slope approximation is used

judge.governing_law_identified: Linearized capillary-gravity first integral gives z''(x)=z(x)/ell^2, with z'(0)=tan(theta0) and z(infinity)=0
judge.regime_assumed: Small-slope approximation |z'(x)| << 1; decaying far-field branch for x >= 0

judge.governing_law_identified: Hydrostatic pressure P = P0 - rho g z, cancellation of atmospheric-pressure contributions, and horizontal components of surface-tension forces at the two contact points
judge.regime_assumed: Static equilibrium; uniform surface tension; force reported per unit length along the y-axis; rod contour has submerged contact points at za and zb

judge.governing_law_identified: Capillary-hydrostatic invariant along the water surface, combined with horizontal force balance from C.1
judge.regime_assumed: Static equilibrium with a symmetric midpoint surface where z = z0 and cos(theta) = 1, and a flat far-field surface with z = 0

judge.governing_law_identified: The linearized capillary-surface equation z'' = z/ℓ^2, with symmetry at the midpoint giving z'(0)=0; hence z(x)=z0 cosh(x/ℓ).
judge.regime_assumed: Small-slope approximation and left-right symmetry of the two identical rods; x_a is taken as the positive coordinate of the left contact point of rod B.
